summary: Frontend-only E2E review of MiniDev landing page completed. Build passes; desktop/mobile navigation, anchors, FAQ, CTAs, and overflow checks pass.

integration_issues.issue: Preview DOM does not contain og:title or og:description despite source index.html declaring them; verify deployment/build head preservation.

action_items: Ensure OpenGraph title and description are present in the served preview DOM.
Add data-testid to the mockup Start button and footer brand link to satisfy the stated testability contract.
critical_code_review_comments: Two rendered interactive elements lack data-testid: mockup Start button and footer brand anchor.
seed_data_creation: None; static landing page, no APIs used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified https://minidev-beta.preview.emergentagent.com at 1920px, 768px, and 375px. Hero/title, all main anchors, three placeholder CTA hrefs, FAQ toggle, mobile menu open/close, and no horizontal overflow passed. Build passed with yarn build.
rca of the issue: OpenGraph metadata is declared in the checked-in public/index.html but absent from the served document head during browser inspection, indicating preview/build head transformation or deployment mismatch. Missing test IDs originate from App.js elements rendered without data-testid.
